body:
From the #569 follow-up (`fix/569-plot-registration`, plot_labor/plot_inputs registration).

- Rows destroyed: Burkina_Faso 2018-19 163 of 22,877 (150 conflicting tuples); Senegal 10; CotedIvoire 1; Niger 51 / 35 / 6 / 3. Niger is tracked under #614 / #637.
- These are replayed from the grain-audit stamp; r1 reproduced the counts.
- Benin and Togo fixed the same class by making `harmonize_seed_crop` injective and asserting uniqueness in the wave script. Burkina_Faso, Senegal and CotedIvoire lack that fix.
- **Tier:** B, likely under #637.
title: #569 residual F: wave-level destructive collapses in EHCVM `plot_inputs` (Country path, pre-existing)
